page.layout: One column of running text. Run-in italic lemmas open the paragraphs. Page number top left. Catchword bottom right. Decorative running head only, no text.

main_text.p: affertur. Dixit autem IUS ANTI-QUUM, pro, formulam Aquilianam ad ius antiquum aptam atque accommodatam.

Quod quaerendum est.) Id est, quod etiam quaeri poteft. Mirum est autem, primùm quòd nō prius superiori quae stioni respondeat, quàm noua interpositá lectoris memoriam conturbet: deinde quòd hanc quaestionem quasi ab altera diuersam tractet, cum eadem plane, si ius spectes, aut certè ipsius maximè gemina, similisq; sit.
Redeatq; mortuo.) Recte: cùm in quibusdam corruptissimè legatur VIVO. subauditur autem, Patre & auo.

Nihil refert.) Vt suam quaestionem Ceruidius ipse, quàuis argutà ac subtilem, tamè superuacaneam esse fatea-tur, reuocareq; hic locus in memoriam nobis possit illud Ciceronis ex lib. Offic. primo: complures in iure ciuili esse, qui nimis magnum studium, multamq; operam in res obscuras atq; difficiles conferunt, easdemq; non necessarias.

page.notes: Run-in lemmas (Quod quaerendum est., Redeatq; mortuo., Nihil refert.) are set in italic at paragraph starts within the text column and are transcribed in place. "quae stioni" is printed with a space at the line end, left as printed. "Offic." is written whole, its printed line-end break ("Of fic.") is not a hyphen. A stray dark mark at the left edge beside the second paragraph is not printed text and is omitted. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Running head ornaments are omitted, as they contain no words.
